summary: iter164 — Validated the new 'Schede di Produzione' (maestro) lab UI + hands-free voice controls and the lab shift/fault-log backend. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (/api/lab/fault-log GET+POST anonymous, ordering desc, no _id leak, /api/lab/shift-state GET/PUT persistence + 422 validation). Frontend (mobile 390x844): clean startup with default view braccio-lab, NO voice-onboard / mode-badge / voice-command-btn in DOM, hands-free card 'Assistant listening' + ear toggle present and toggling styles (dark <-> orange with ping), 4 renamed nav tabs (Master Recipes / Science & Guides / Production Sheets / Community), Emergenze flow (emg-consegne, machine toggle -> shift note + fault-log entry, cold toggle -> note, emg-autonomy time row, base-expiry badge in emg-bases), RicettaDelGiorno (autonomy hint with '⏰ Work autonomously until 22:30', admin login + weekly plan -> list -> detail -> precotto -> rdg-bases summary with expiry ⏳), maestro-back-btn on every tool, tab re-tap returns to Braccio, Gestione view + 'Operative mode' back button, zero-scroll respected (scrollHeight == innerHeight = 844). Only 2 minor issues found (fault-log UI refresh race, pre-existing nested <button> DOM error in RecipeList).

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: logFault() dispatches 'mikilab-faultlog-updated' immediately WITHOUT awaiting the POST /api/lab/fault-log, so the 'Storico guasti' list sometimes re-fetches before the insert is visible. Reproduced: after emg-cold-toggle the entry was correctly created in Mongo (verified via API: type=cella 'Cold cell') but the emg-faultlog list stayed at 4 entries until reload. Fix: await the POST then dispatch (or optimistically prepend the entry).
Console error (React DOM validation): nested <button> inside <button> — recipe-fav-* button rendered inside recipe-row-* button. Pre-existing, causes hydration warning/error on the Ricette tab.

issues: Labels use 'break-all' with 9px font, so words are split mid-word: 'Science & Guide s', 'Production She ets'. Use break-words / smaller tracking instead.
Several background calls return 401 for anonymous users (notifications/greetings) producing console noise on every load; harmless but should be gated behind `user`.

action_items: shiftState.logFault: await POST /lab/fault-log before dispatching 'mikilab-faultlog-updated' (or optimistically add the entry) so Storico guasti updates immediately.
RecipeList: move the favourite button out of the recipe row <button> (nested button DOM error).
BottomNav: replace 'break-all' with 'break-words' so tab labels are not split mid-word.

Optional cleanup: App.js line 21 still imports ModeBadge with an eslint-disable (dead import); /api/lab-config currently contains a leftover test mixer 'TEST Impastatrice QA' from a previous iteration.
Optional: skip anonymous-only 401 calls (notifications/greetings) to reduce console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: shiftState.logFault fire-and-forget POST + immediate event = stale UI (see action items).
Maestro.jsx persists labView in localStorage; a user last left in 'gestione' will NOT get the new default 'Braccio' view on startup — consider migrating/clearing 'mikilab_lab_view' once.
VoiceCommand.jsx (578 lines) and Maestro.jsx keep growing; the onboarding JSX block (voice-onboard) is dead code since onboard is permanently false — remove it.
/api/lab/fault-log has no pruning/delete endpoint; collection grows unbounded (GET caps at 200 which mitigates response size only).

rca_of_the_issue: Fault-log UI staleness: lib/shiftState.js logFault() calls api.post(...).catch() and then synchronously dispatches 'mikilab-faultlog-updated'; the Emergenze listener performs GET /lab/fault-log which can run before the insert is committed/returned, so the newly created fault does not appear until a manual reload.
